system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.

Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Build a verifiable floating-base mobile robot named OmniCartClimbE. The resulting scenario must make the following behavior testable: Ascend a 12 degree ramp, traverse a 2 m plateau, and stop before the descending edge. Represent the plant without omitting its structure. A 25 kg box platform carries four 0.095 m-radius mecanum wheels at 45 degree roller angle on a 0.58 m by 0.46 m footprint. Four wheel-torque actuators produce holonomic body motion, with command magnitude bounded by 13.2 N.m. Encoders, an IMU, and a forward depth sensor measure speed, attitude, and edge distance. Use friction 0.76 and add two 0.05 m-height surface ridges. Apply slip-aware traction control with bounded braking and a controlled 180 N payload force middle-third disturbance. Run at 250 Hz for 16 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Acceptance is fail-closed. Require actuator limits, slip ratio below 0.35, roll and pitch below 0.40 rad, and stopping margin, primary tracking error below 0.162 m/s after 10.4 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.

The previous model did not compile. Repair it and return one complete model.

model OmniCartClimbE "Floating-base mecanum robot: ascend 12 deg ramp, traverse 2 m plateau, stop before edge" constant Real g = 9.81 "Gravitational acceleration [m/s2]"; constant Real pi = 3.14159265358979; // ===== Platform Parameters (from requirement) ===== parameter Real m = 25.0 "Platform mass [kg]"; parameter Real Lx = 0.58 "Footprint length [m]"; parameter Real Ly = 0.46 "Footprint width [m]"; parameter Real r_w = 0.095 "Wheel radius [m]"; // ===== Derived/Assumed Platform Parameters ===== parameter Real h_pl = 0.08 "Platform thickness [m] — assumed"; parameter Real I_pitch = m * (Lx ^ 2 + 4 * h_pl ^ 2) / 12 "Pitch inertia [kg.m2] — thin plate"; parameter Real I_roll = m * (Ly ^ 2 + 4 * h_pl ^ 2) / 12 "Roll inertia [kg.m2] — thin plate"; parameter Real J_w = 0.015 "Wheel inertia [kg.m2] — assumed"; parameter Real k_pitch = 800.0 "Pitch stiffness [N.m/rad] — assumed"; parameter Real c_pitch = 30.0 "Pitch damping [N.m.s/rad] — assumed"; parameter Real k_roll = 600.0 "Roll stiffness [N.m/rad] — assumed"; parameter Real c_roll = 20.0 "Roll damping [N.m.s/rad] — assumed"; parameter Real b_visc = 1.5 "Viscous drag [N.s/m] — assumed"; parameter Real b_w = 0.002 "Wheel damping [N.m.s/rad] — assumed"; parameter Real k_slip = 40.0 "Traction slip stiffness [1/(m/s)] — assumed"; // ===== Terrain Parameters ===== parameter Real ramp_angle_deg = 12.0 "Ramp angle [deg]"; parameter Real ramp_angle = ramp_angle_deg * pi / 180 "Ramp angle [rad]"; parameter Real x_ramp_start = 0.5 "Ramp start [m] — assumed"; // ===== Disturbance Parameters ===== parameter Real F_payload = 180.0 "Payload disturbance force [N]"; parameter Real t_dist_start = 16.0 / 3.0 "Disturbance start [s] — middle third"; parameter Real t_dist_end = 2.0 * 16.0 / 3.0 "Disturbance end [s] — middle third"; equation // ===== Terrain Model ===== z_base = if x_pos < x_ramp_start then 0.0 elseif x_pos < x_ramp_start + ramp_length then (x_pos - x_ramp_start) * tan(ramp_angle) elseif x_pos < x_ramp_start + ramp_length + plateau_length then ramp_length * tan(ramp_angle) else ramp_length * tan(ramp_angle) - (x_pos - x_ramp_start - ramp_length - plateau_length) * tan(ramp_angle); track_err = v_ref - v_x; // ===== Slip Ratios ===== v_safe = if abs(v_x) > eps_v then v_x else eps_v; slip1 = (omega1 * r_w - v_x) / max(abs(v_safe), 1e-6); slip2 = (omega2 * r_w - v_x) / max(abs(v_safe), 1e-6); slip3 = (omega3 * r_w - v_x) / max(abs(v_safe), 1e-6); slip4 = (omega4 * r_w - v_x) / max(abs(v_safe), 1e-6); slip_max_val = max(abs(slip1), max(abs(slip2), max(abs(slip3), abs(slip4)))); // ===== Traction Forces (tanh friction model) ===== F_tr1 = mu * N_per_wheel * tanh(k_slip * (omega1 * r_w - v_x)); F_tr2 = mu * N_per_wheel * tanh(k_slip * (omega2 * r_w - v_x)); F_tr3 = mu * N_per_wheel * tanh(k_slip * (omega3 * r_w - v_x)); F_tr4 = mu * N_per_wheel * tanh(k_slip * (omega4 * r_w - v_x)); F_tr_total = F_tr1 + F_tr2 + F_tr3 + F_tr4; J_w * der(omega4) = tau4_act - F_tr4 * r_w - b_w * omega4; // ===== Longitudinal Dynamics ===== m * der(v_x) = F_tr_total - F_grav - F_dist - b_visc * v_x; der(x_pos) = v_x; // ===== Pitch Dynamics (terrain following) ===== I_pitch * der(pitch_rate) = k_pitch * (slope_terrain - pitch) - c_pitch * pitch_rate; // ===== Sensors ===== v_enc = (omega1 + omega2 + omega3 + omega4) * r_w / 4.0; roll_imu = roll; pitch_imu = pitch; // ===== Discrete Control at 250 Hz ===== when sample(0, Ts) then // Tracking error track_err_d = v_ref - v_enc; // Integral with anti-windup err_int_d = max(-5.0, min(5.0, pre(err_int_d) + track_err_d * Ts)); // Slip-aware torque scaling if slip_max_val > slip_thresh then slip_scale_local = max(0.3, 1.0 - (slip_max_val - slip_thresh) / (slip_limit - slip_thresh)); else slip_scale_local = 1.0; end if; // Raw torque command torque_raw_local = kp_v * track_err_d + ki_v * err_int_d; // Fault detection and latch if slip_max_val > slip_limit or abs(roll) > roll_limit or abs(pitch) > pitch_limit or (time > t_track_check and abs(track_err) > track_err_limit) or (x_pos > x_edge - 0.05 and abs(v_x) > 0.05) or not (x_pos > -1e6 and x_pos < 1e6 and v_x > -1e6 and v_x < 1e6 and roll > -1e2 and roll < 1e2 and pitch > -1e2 and pitch < 1e2) then fault_latch = true; // ===== Continuous Fault Detection ===== fault_actuator = abs(tau1_cmd) > tau_max + 0.01 or abs(tau2_cmd) > tau_max + 0.01 or abs(tau3_cmd) > tau_max + 0.01 or abs(tau4_cmd) > tau_max + 0.01; fault_slip = slip_max_val > slip_limit;
